title: Understanding Probability Assignments
text: Consider how the probabilities $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.8\$$$ and $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.6\$$$ are assigned to different groups of points. What does this tell you about the likelihood of $$\$Y=1\$$$ for each group?

title: Interpreting ROC Curves
text: Think about what an ROC curve represents. How does it relate to the true positive rate and false positive rate?

title: Probability and ROC Curves
text: Given the probabilities $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.8\$$$ and $$\$P(Y=1|X)=0.6\$$$, which ROC curve would likely show a higher true positive rate?

title: Connecting Probabilities to ROC
text: If a classifier assigns a higher probability to $$\$Y=1\$$$, how might this affect the position of the ROC curve?
